description: This shell script extracts embedded trash directories from logs, identified by specific start and end markers, and decompresses their contents. It processes log lines, identifies sections between markers, cleans CR characters, and extracts archived data.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits with a status code of 1.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines from standard input to detect the start of an embedded trash directory, setting a global variable with the directory name.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines from standard input and outputs lines until the end of a specified trash directory, handling errors if the end marker is missing.
